comment: Source of truth for every asset SeaGlobe loads or plans to load. tools/build_assets.py fills bytes and sha256 from the files and writes web/data/assets.js and web/assets.json. tier repo = always in the app folder; tier large = R2 copy when a base URL is set, else the smaller fallback in the repo, else not available. r2 keys are relative to the R2 base URL; paths are relative to the site root.
r2_staging: local folder holding the exact files to upload to R2 (outside the repository)
